zeal_detector.py is adapted from upstream detector.py. Local modifications:
- Fit a vertical background gradient for neutral grey themes; retain the
  upstream colour model for chromatic themes, including translucent wood.
- Use a narrower body mask plus a separate head mask for nearby platforms.
- Refine nearby symmetric tops from their unoccluded upper rows.
This change passes all 165 precision and 1085 regression samples, and fixes a live grey-theme
frame whose original predicted target was 19 canonical pixels off-centre.
The pressure-time calculation in ../vision.py uses locally fitted directional
curves from this computer's measured landing offsets, inferred using the
camera midpoint and reliable next-platform hints, with 100--1600ms limits.
The local PreciseInput.cs/.exe worker isolates timed holds from Python/Tk.

Local additions: Windows capture/input, DPI handling, UI, hotkey stop,
coordinate normalization, output validation, precision timing, calibration
controls, constrained global centre-hint detection, safe between-jump pause,
and camera-axis turn correction.
Upstream Linux/X11 automation and optional LLM integration are not invoked.

score_templates.npz contains normalized glyphs extracted from the upstream
Apache-2.0 precision screenshots 001--007, 014, 015 and 023.
The ten labels were visually verified locally. The local score reader is new code.

The turn-distance strategy is also described by zaijiejud/PlayJumpGame:
https://github.com/zaijiejud/PlayJumpGame
The local implementation uses the detected camera midpoint and persists direction.
